name: mini-rpg
description: Mini RPG — v1 (RPG), v2 (2D village) и v3 «Пепел и Зерно» (survival sandbox / colony builder). Dependency-free browser game.
author: shironaki

scripts.test: node tests/game.test.js && node tests/integration.test.js && node v2/tests/engine.test.js && node v2/tests/battle.test.js && node v2/tests/menus.test.js && node v2/tests/smoke.test.js && npm run test:v3
scripts.check: for f in js/*.js scripts/*.js tests/*.js v2/js/main.js v2/js/*/*.js v2/tests/*.js v3/js/main.js v3/js/*/*.js v3/tests/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'syntax OK'
scripts.test:v3: node v3/tests/core.test.js && node v3/tests/world.test.js && node v3/tests/survival.test.js && node v3/tests/story.test.js && node v3/tests/smoke.test.js && node v3/tests/game.test.js
